title: A support-changing natural-gradient flow in the established kappa geometry
question: can the kappa entropy geometry produce a law with the critical-line ledger as unique invariant state?

verdict.conclusion: The normalized Rankin feature family has a canonical Fisher-natural gradient of relative entropy. It gives d eta/dt=-eta, hence eta(t)=exp(-t)eta(0), and at t=log(phi) gives the exact golden support contraction. Delta at eta=0 is its unique invariant finite-probability ledger. However, proving that the actual completed xi zero ledger is invariant under this support-changing flow is RH-equivalent and is not supplied by the functional equation or the prime ledger.

establishedGeometry.note: kappa_R is retained as derived; its global scalar cancels when feature intensities are normalized to probabilities

uniqueInvariantAudit.statement: if a finite probability ledger mu with finite second moment satisfies T_t push(mu)=mu for one t>0, then mu is supported at eta=0
uniqueInvariantAudit.proof: invariance gives integral eta^2 dmu=exp(-2t) integral eta^2 dmu; because exp(-2t)<1, the second moment is zero
uniqueInvariantAudit.applicationToXi: for each finite-height normalized zero ledger, invariance would force every represented zero onto the critical line
uniqueInvariantAudit.status: the invariant-measure statement is a conditional RH proof, not a derived invariance law for xi

xiBridgeAudit.functionalEquation: proves reflection symmetry eta <-> -eta, not invariance under eta -> exp(-t)eta
xiBridgeAudit.quartetEffect: contracting eta changes the quartet polynomial coefficients and therefore changes the completed entire function
xiBridgeAudit.holomorphicBoundary: the horizontal flow keeps gamma fixed and is nonholomorphic as a map of s
xiBridgeAudit.primeBoundary: no principal von Mangoldt identity has been shown stationary under this flow
xiBridgeAudit.noBirthBoundary: the constructed transport has no births by definition, but identifying its transported ledger with the same xi ledger is unproved

pureStateLiftDiagnostic.necessaryCondition: for one CPTP map sending every normalized pure v_eta to pure v_(c eta), the environment overlap quotient Q_ij=C(eta_i,eta_j)/C(c eta_i,c eta_j) must be positive semidefinite
pureStateLiftDiagnostic.interpretation: the negative five-point pivot is a finite numerical obstruction to an exact global pure-state channel lift; it is not a directed-rounding impossibility proof

openSystemBoundary.deterministicNature: the support semigroup compresses spectral-coordinate distributions; their differential entropy decreases, so an environment must receive the missing information
openSystemBoundary.additiveNoise: adding ordinary diffusion produces a nonzero-width stationary law rather than delta at the critical line and can leak toward the strip boundary
neededCompletion: derive this natural-gradient transport from the physical splice rather than select it from information geometry alone
prove the completed xi zero ledger or an equivalent prime-side functional is stationary under it
lift the law consistently to the completed entire function or supply a controlled open-system replacement
retain the no-birth property at unbounded height

status: a canonical support-changing candidate with unique critical invariant has been found; its same-xi or principal-prime invariance remains unproved, so RH remains open
